name: hud_ui_layout_node_read_rect_offset_and_size
description: HudUiLayoutNode::ReadRectOffsetAndSize reads left/top/right/bottom from a ZRDR array node, optionally applies an x/y offset, and optionally returns width and height.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this helper is deferred to a coherent HUD layout/source-cluster tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x413a10 validates rejecting non-array nodes, reading array entries 1 through 4 into left/top/right/bottom, applying offsetXY[0] and offsetXY[1] to both corners when present, and writing optional width/height as right-left and bottom-top.
The native smoke verifies shifted and unshifted array reads, optional height omission, width/height derivation, and that non-array input returns 0 without modifying outputs.
